messages:
Nico: Quick flag from vendor: H200 bulk pushed to late July, B200 has a certification quirk. Need marketplace sequencing decisions.
Sara: Which wave had B200/H200?
Nico: Wave C originally. Wave B had MI300 + Gaudi. H200 was expected in Wave C.
Hiro: Lab: MI300 tests failing intermittently on ROCm 5.6; vendor working on patch.
Ben: Sales: enterprise pilots asked for B200 perf. If delayed, offer H100x fallback?
Clara: Ops: we can route batches to H100x and mark B200 as "coming soon". Create SKU tag "preview".
partner-bot: Reminder: partner press embargo requires 72h lead and signed approval.
Nico: Proposal: ship Wave A (H100, Gaudi) on 2026-06-10, Wave B soft-gated (MI300 pending ROCm), Wave C (B200/H200) later.
Sara: Agree. Also offer limited SI preview for B200 with NDA.
Hiro: Technical action: reproduce MI300 kernel oops, attach logs. Patch ETA ~5 days per vendor.
Ben: I'll inform customers and offer preview seats. Need alpha invite list.
Clara: Ops will stand up small canary pool (H100x emulating B200) for SI perf testing.
Nico: Add marketing note: "Rolling availability; specific SKUs subject to partner timelines." Conservative language.
Sara: Also label MI300 SKU as "beta driver" until we pass e2e.
Hiro: Adding health checks to block promotion if kernel errors > 0 in 24h.
Ben: SIs ok with preview if we provide benchmarking kit and clear SLA caveats.
Clara: I'll add SKU flags: rolling-availability, preview, beta-driver.
partner-bot: Note: record embargo decisions in PRR doc.
Nico: Actions: Hiro reproduce + upload logs; Clara create canary + SKU flags; Ben draft SI invites; Sara draft customer messaging. Update thread when done.
Ben: Uploaded alpha list to internal doc.
Hiro: Logs in ticket HW-855. Vendor says patch request submitted.
Sara: Draft customer note posted.
Nico: Closing thread, will reopen after vendor patch or new dates.
